result.summary: Found 1 minor styling inconsistency. The page otherwise renders correctly.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) buttons on the two 'Popular right now' cards are styled inconsistently. The ramen card shows a heart with no background circle, while the pizza card shows a heart inside a dark filled circle.
issues.suggestion: Use a consistent heart/favorite button style across all restaurant cards, ideally with the same background treatment for readability over varying imagery.
